WHAT: extractTask() in transcript.ts processes raw user prompts into clean 3-8 word titles
WHERE: src/lib/transcript.ts
HOW:
1. Strip common prefixes: 'Implement the following plan:', 'implement ', 'please ', 'can you ', 'could you ', 'i need ', etc.
2. Strip markdown: lines starting with #, **, *, -, > 
3. Take first non-empty line after stripping
4. Trim leading dashes/spaces (leftover from markdown stripping)
5. Truncate to 60 chars

EXAMPLE: 'Implement the following plan: # Pixel Office → Management Tool Upgrade ## Context...' → 'Pixel Office → Management Tool Upgrade'

FALLBACK: full text if nothing survived stripping

extractCurrentFocus(lines, count=4): reads last N user messages from transcript tail, takes most recent one, applies same extraction. Used for focus line from transcript reader (no longer primary mechanism — UserPromptSubmit hook is primary).

GOTCHA: Session task is cached — once set at session-start, won't update unless session is re-created. Component-level cleanup: trim leading '— ' in WorkerPanel/WorkerPopup/ApprovalToast for backward compat with old cached values.
